slope attached sideways to face of black bracket

inverted slope studs into underside of towball plate
left leg attached under body base plate (assumed)
right leg attached under body base plate (assumed)

notes: Booklet images are low-resolution; many positions, layers and attachment points are best guesses.

Step numbers count every sub-assembly sub-step and every 'attach sub-assembly' step in booklet order: arm A sub-steps 4-5, attach 6, arm B 7-8, attach 9, main steps 6-16 = 10-20, leg 1 sub-steps 21-24, attach 25, leg 2 sub-steps 26-29, attach 30, step 19 = 31.
Arms are modelled as a hinge plate on the body stud row, with the second arm stacked on the first. The clip plate and curved brick sit on the hanging half, so their positions are null.
Eyes (ball joints) are assumed to plug into the two light-grey towball-socket plates p9/p10.
The leg attachment to the body is unclear in the booklet. I assumed it goes under the base plate p14 through the inverted slopes.
Flames are assumed to attach at the side studs of p1 (back).
The tooth plate, slope and belly wedge attach sideways to bracket faces, so their positions are null.
Leg sub-assembly pieces are off-grid (ball joints), so their positions are null.
The inverted slopes p22/p23 attach to the underside of the towball plates, but the sub-step order puts them later. Their rests_on is empty and the join is in other_joins.
